settings.heading: Aesthetics Meet Everyday Utility.
settings.text: We believe that the objects around us shape our daily peace. Every detail is meticulously planned, and every material is chosen for its timeless quality.

settings.point_desc: Transform your kitchen into a calm, stress-free sanctuary.
Find what you need in seconds, not minutes.
Protect your belongings with anti-skid and premium-grade materials.

settings.title: Our Vision
settings.description: To redefine modern Indian living by transforming every house into a clutter-free sanctuary where world-class aesthetics meet effortless daily utility, bringing lasting peace of mind to families.

settings.title: Our Mission
settings.description: To design and deliver premium, highly functional, and durable organizational solutions that solve everyday home frustrations, making it simple for people to elevate their spaces, save time, and live more mindfully.

settings.title: Core Values
settings.description: To build beautiful, high-quality organizational solutions that combine intelligent utility with timeless design, helping Indian families create a calm, clutter-free, and mindful home environment.

settings.heading: The Heart of Housious
settings.story_text: Housious was born out of a simple, everyday frustration. We realized that a cluttered kitchen or an unorganized space isn't just a physical hassle—it directly affects your peace of mind. Our founder envisioned a brand that brings international standards of durability and modern aesthetics into Indian homes, making utility look beautiful.
settings.quote: A tidy space leads to a peaceful mind.
